name: wire-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the wire design verification for the checked-in harness example. Run `/wire:gates` on the workspace contract (or `python3 $WIRE_PLUGIN/scripts/wire_launcher.py gates <contract>`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the design report, and write a short result to records/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
